title: Lindy Lou Charters

services.name: Kid Fishing
services.desc: Our inshore fishing will take place in the bay and back bayous around docks, bridges, oyster beds, grass flats and other structures. You will dock hop or drift along grass flats mainly targeting Redfish and Speckled Trout. In spring time, we will also do some inshore trolling for Spanish Mackerel or fish the bridges
